summary: Mastra remains a strong runtime candidate but should not be promoted until high-severity integration blockers are resolved.

evidence.reason: Human review and suspend/resume contract passed.
Every major stage has a local trace event linked to an artifact.
Retry/recovery and safe-failure scenarios passed as local contracts.

blockers.reason: Langfuse qualification is still a local trace contract, not SDK emission.
Suspend/resume is modeled as a contract, not verified against real Mastra runtime API.
Failure qualification defines retry expectations but does not execute real Mastra retry behavior.
Human review is simulated locally rather than injected from an external decision source.

requiredForPromotion: inject human review decision from external input
regenerate promotion report with no open high-severity blockers
decisionBoundary: Mastra may become the Hermes runtime layer, but Hermes domain logic, scoring, promotion criteria, and artifacts must remain framework-independent.
